name: MiniCPM-V-4_6
notes: THE MOST ARCHITECTURALLY INTERESTING RECORD IN THIS SLICE, and the only non-dense one. TWO-PART MODEL. (1) Vision: SigLIP, 27 layers, hidden 1152, 16 heads, patch 14, image_size 980, gelu_pytorch_tanh, insert_layer_id 6 -- vision features are injected at layer 6 of the LLM rather than only at the input. image_size 1120 at top level, image_token_id 248056, video_token_id 248057. (2) LLM: text_config model_type qwen3_5_text -- 24 layers, hidden 1024, 8 heads / 2 KV heads, head_dim 256 (4x wider than hidden_size/num_heads), intermediate 3584, vocab 248,094, max_position 262,144, rope_theta 1e7, partial_rotary_factor 0.25 (only a quarter of head dims get RoPE), tie_word_embeddings true, attn_output_gate true, mtp_num_hidden_layers 1 (multi-token prediction head), linear_conv_kernel_dim 4, mamba_ssm_dtype float32. ARCHITECTURE = hybrid-attention-ssm, and this is the whole point: the layer_types array spells out exactly 6 full_attention layers at indices 3, 7, 11, 15, 19, 23 and 18 linear_attention layers everywhere else, in a strict 3:1 repeating pattern. KV CACHE: 6 full-attention layers * 2 kv_heads * 256 head_dim * 2 * 2 bytes = 12,288 B/token (12 KiB). The 18 linear_attention layers hold a FIXED-SIZE recurrent state (linear_key_head_dim 128, linear_value_head_dim 128, linear_num_key_heads 16, linear_num_value_heads 16) that does not grow with context, so they contribute a constant ~18 * 16 * 128 * 2 * 4 bytes ~= 0.3 MiB per sequence TOTAL, independent of context length. THIS IS 12x SMALLER PER TOKEN than MiniCPM-V-4_5 (147,456 B) despite being a similar generation, and it is the only record here where a 262,144-token context is a realistic serving target: 262,144 * 12,288 B = 3.0 GiB resident KV. The 18:6 ratio is the knob to tune -- every layer converted from full to linear attention removes 2,048 B/token. VISION TOKENS: not derivable from this config -- the resampler/tiling fields (query_num, slice_config) that MiniCPM-V-4_5 exposes are absent here, and the vision_config block carries no image_seq_len. Given the shared SigLIP-980/patch-14 tower the per-slice cost is likely comparable to the 4.5's 64 tokens, but that is an INFERENCE and is deliberately not asserted here. params_b 1.300 = HF API safetensors total (1,300,428,016) -- a 1.3B multimodal model, so this generation is a large step down in size from 4_5's 8.7B. transformers_version 5.7.0. Released 2026-04-13, the most recent checkpoint in this slice.
